findings.title: Pagination semantics: in-memory offset/limit after v3 side-table load
evidence: Service loads full events via bundle_events_or_legacy, then applies offset/limit in memory
next_offset = Some(offset + returned.len()) when more remain; None when fully consumed
Out-of-range offset returns empty slice with next_offset = None

findings.title: Missing bundle surfaces as ServiceError::LoadFailed at service + MCP boundary
evidence: Service checks load_counterexample_bundle -> empty -> returns LoadFailed with explicit bundle_id in message
MCP tool handler maps the error to CallToolResult::error

findings.title: TraceEvent lacks JsonSchema impl; DTO used #[schemars(skip)] on the events Vec
evidence: TraceEvent derives Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq — but not JsonSchema
Pragmatic fix — the inner events remain on the wire via their serde representation; the schema-generation simply treats them as opaque
